# VERIDIAN DPDP — full text

> dpdp.veridian-aios.com is Indian software for running DPDP compliance, purpose-built for the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 and DPDP Rules 2025, for CA, CS, audit and legal firms, their clients, and companies, institutions, schools and NGOs.

This is the visible text of every public page of https://veridian-aios.com.

## DPDP Compliance Management Software for India — https://veridian-aios.com/

### The DPDP Act asks every organisation for four things
1. Know what data you hold.
2. Tell people about it.
3. Keep it safe.
4. Prove it — with a record that outlasts the person who set it up.
🧑‍⚖️ I AM A CA / CS / LEGAL / AUDIT FIRM — DOING FOR MY CLIENTS 🏭 I AM A COMPANY / INSTITUTION / SCHOOL / NGO — DOING FOR OURSELVES
Already have an account? Sign in
### What VERIDIAN (VERy INDIAN) is
dpdp.veridian-aios.com is Indian software for running DPDP compliance, purpose-built for the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 and DPDP Rules 2025, for CA, CS, audit and legal firms, their clients, and companies, institutions, schools and NGOs.
Who it is for:
1. CA, CS, audit and legal firms · their clients
2. Companies, institutions, schools and NGOs
- It turns the law into a list of jobs, gives each job to the responsible person, and coordinates every stakeholder — owners, staff, vendors, group companies — through one email a week, with no accounts or passwords.
- Each answer is recorded with a date and cannot be edited, building the proof an organisation needs.
- Every job is mapped to its legal source, including the SPDI Rules 2011 that apply until 13 May 2027.
It is not a law firm, does not certify (no DPDP certification exists in India), does not guarantee compliance, and never stores documents.
About VERIDIAN
About VERIDIAN

## DPDP Act Compliance for CA, CS, Audit and Legal Firms — https://veridian-aios.com/dpdp-firm/

For CA, CS, audit and legal firms
### DPDP compliance for all your clients, in one place
Give each client a list of jobs. Chase the answers by email. Keep a dated record nobody can edit.
Start free →
Your own firm's file is free. No licence fee. You pay per client file, after you have billed the client.
### What VERIDIAN (VERy INDIAN) is
dpdp.veridian-aios.com is Indian software for running DPDP compliance, purpose-built for the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 and DPDP Rules 2025, for CA, CS, audit and legal firms, their clients, and companies, institutions, schools and NGOs.

2. Companies, institutions, schools and NGOs

About VERIDIAN
### How it works
🧾 Add each client Name the client and choose the type of organisation. Invite the owner by email.
📋 We list the jobs VERIDIAN turns the Act into jobs. Each job has a person, a date and its legal source.
📧 People answer by email Each person gets one email a week and answers from the inbox. No accounts or passwords.
### What you get
👥 Every client has its own file Add as many clients as you serve. Keep each one apart.
🗂️ Jobs with names and dates Every job has a person, a due date and its legal source.
✍️ Checks and sign-off The owner confirms. Your manager checks. Your partner signs.
🛡️ A record nobody can edit Every answer is dated and kept. Nobody can change it later.
🤖 Your own AI assistant Give it a private, time-limited link from inside VERIDIAN.
🗄️ We keep no documents We keep a fingerprint, a name and a date. The file stays with you.
### What we do, and where we stop
✅ We do Turn the Act into jobs · Give each job to a person · Chase the answers · Keep a dated record
🚫 We do not Touch your systems · Keep your documents · Give legal advice · Certify you as compliant · Promise that nobody will be fined
### Questions people ask
Do you touch our systems?
No. We do not connect to your software, read your files or install anything. We record what you tell us.
Do you keep our documents?
No. We keep a fingerprint, a name and a date. The document stays with you, so keep your own originals.
Can you certify us as compliant?
No. There is no government DPDP certification in India. We help you do the work and keep the record.
What if we stop paying?
Your record stays readable and can be exported. You lose new entries, not old ones.
Has anyone been fined yet?
No penalty order has been issued in India to date. The date to prepare for is 13 May 2027.
### Start with one client
One email. No card. Fifteen minutes.
Start free →
VERIDIAN · VERy INDIAN
Your DPDP proof — not just your DPDP policy. People move on. The proof stays.

dpdp.veridian-aios.com is Indian software for running DPDP compliance, purpose-built for the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 and DPDP Rules 2025, for CA, CS, audit and legal firms, their clients, and companies, institutions, schools and NGOs.

👨‍👩‍👧 Parents' consent, on a link Parents give consent item by item. Withdrawing is the same tap as agreeing.
🎧 A Grievance Officer, published Name your officer on a public page. The law asks for it.

### What we do, and where we stop
✅ We do Turn the Act into jobs · Give each job to a person · Chase the answers · Keep a dated record
🚫 We do not Touch your systems · Keep your documents · Give legal advice · Certify you as compliant · Promise that nobody will be fined
### Questions people ask
We are small. Does this apply to us?
Yes. There is no size exemption in the Act. A ten-person firm holding customer phone numbers is a Data Fiduciary.
Do you touch our systems?
No. We do not connect to your software, read your files or install anything. We record what you tell us.
Do you keep our documents?
No. We keep a fingerprint, a name and a date. The document stays with you, so keep your own originals.
Can you certify us as compliant?
No. There is no government DPDP certification in India. We help you do the work and keep the record.
Has anyone been fined yet?
No penalty order has been issued in India to date. The date to prepare for is 13 May 2027.
Do we need a special email address?
No. Sign-in is a link to whatever address you use: Gmail, Yahoo or your own domain.

## About VERIDIAN — https://veridian-aios.com/about/

### About VERIDIAN
### What VERIDIAN (VERy INDIAN) is
dpdp.veridian-aios.com is Indian software for running DPDP compliance, purpose-built for the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 and DPDP Rules 2025, for CA, CS, audit and legal firms, their clients, and companies, institutions, schools and NGOs.
Who it is for:
1. CA, CS, audit and legal firms · their clients
2. Companies, institutions, schools and NGOs
- It turns the law into a list of jobs, gives each job to the responsible person, and coordinates every stakeholder — owners, staff, vendors, group companies — through one email a week, with no accounts or passwords.
- Each answer is recorded with a date and cannot be edited, building the proof an organisation needs.
- Every job is mapped to its legal source, including the SPDI Rules 2011 that apply until 13 May 2027.
It is not a law firm, does not certify (no DPDP certification exists in India), does not guarantee compliance, and never stores documents.
About VERIDIAN
### Key dates
Every CA firm whose clients hold personal data will need to show DPDP compliance by 13 May 2027 — VERIDIAN is built for exactly that work.
- until 13 May 2027: The SPDI Rules 2011 are in force and apply.
- from 13 May 2027: The Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 and the DPDP Rules 2025 are in force. DPDP compliance is due.
### Where the data is
- The database is in Mumbai, India (Supabase, AWS region ap-south-1).
- Email is sent through Resend, a US company, so the content of every email passes through a US company's service.
- The public website is served by Cloudflare Pages, a global content delivery network.
### Your own AI assistant
Users can give their own AI assistant a private, time-limited AI work link from inside VERIDIAN.
### The company

## Become a Sales Partner — https://veridian-aios.com/partner/

### Become a Sales Partner
Tell CA, CS, audit and legal firms, companies, institutions, schools and NGOs about VERIDIAN. When an organisation you referred pays, you earn a commission.
Become a Sales Partner
You sign in with your email. We send you a link. There is no password.
### Who can be a Sales Partner
Anyone with a VERIDIAN account. Every person who belongs to an organisation in VERIDIAN has a personal link to share.
You do not have an organisation yet? Sign in with your email and open your own. It is free to start.
### How you get your personal link
1. Sign in at /app/ with your email.
2. Open the page of your organisation.
3. Press Share, in the bar at the very top of the page.
4. Copy your link, or send it by WhatsApp or email.
- The link opens our public website. It holds your personal code and nothing else.
- Your code stays the same every time.
### What happens when someone you referred pays
1. A person opens an organisation in VERIDIAN with your code. We note that you referred them.
2. The organisation pays us.
3. We see the money and confirm the payment by hand. Until then, no commission is created.
4. Your commission is created and shows as pending.
- Yearly plan: you earn 20% of the payment. You earn it again on every yearly renewal, for as long as that client stays.
- Monthly plan: you earn 5% of the first month's payment. Later months earn nothing.
- Your own organisation never counts. If you sign up through your own link, you earn nothing.
### How you are paid
We pay by hand, by UPI or bank transfer. Payment is not automatic, and this page does not fix a payout date.
Each commission is marked pending. We mark it paid after we send the money.
After your first referral you can see what you have earned, and what is still pending, in the Share box in the app.
### Please note
We cannot promise that you will earn anything. What you earn depends on whom you refer and whether they pay.
This page does not cover tax on a commission. For a question about a payout or about tax, write to us with the subject "Partner".
### Contact
- Write to dpdp@veridian-aios.com and put the topic in the subject: Grievance, Data request, Sales or Partner
- Grievance Officer: dpdp@veridian-aios.com (subject: Grievance)
